script:
-- [[ TILIN_GUI V1 - WINDOWS 7 AERO FINAL VERSION 🥀 ]] --

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local tilin_gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", CoreGui)
local main_panel = Instance.new("Frame", tilin_gui)
local container = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", main_panel)

-- [ DISEÑO WINDOWS 7 AERO ]
main_panel.Name = "AeroPanel"
main_panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 420)
main_panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.2, 0)
main_panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 190, 220) 
main_panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 
main_panel.Active, main_panel.Draggable = true, true
Instance.new("UICorner", main_panel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", main_panel)
stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); stroke.Thickness = 1.2; stroke.Transparency = 0.5

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", main_panel)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50); title.Text = "  TILIN_GUI V1 🥀"; title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1; title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold; title.TextSize = 20; title.TextXAlignment = "Left"

container.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.78, 0); container.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.16, 0)
container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8; container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
container.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 6, 0); container.ScrollBarThickness = 4
Instance.new("UICorner", container)

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", container); layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8); layout.HorizontalAlignment = "Center"

-- [ FUNCIÓN PARA BOTONES ]
local function addBtn(txt, color, func)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", container)
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, 32); b.BackgroundColor3 = color
    b.Text = txt; b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); b.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold; b.TextSize = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", b)
    grad.Color = ColorSequence.new{ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color)}
    grad.Rotation = -90
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
end

-- ==========================================
-- SCRIPTS (DOG ACTUALIZADO)
-- ==========================================

-- 1. SKYBOX ANIME SADRC7
addBtn("SKYBOX ANIME SADRC7", Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 180), function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Sadrc7-anime-jumpscare-102478"))()
end)

-- 2. DOG (ACTUALIZADO CON TU ÚLTIMO SCRIPT)
addBtn("DOG FULL EFFECT", Color3.fromRGB(139, 69, 19), function()
    local textureID = 130742396
    local skyboxID = 130742397

    function exPro(root)
        for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..textureID then
                v:Destroy()
            elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic; v.Transparency = 0
                local faces = {"Front","Back","Right","Left","Top","Bottom"}
                for _, face in pairs(faces) do
                    local d = Instance.new("Decal")
                    d.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..textureID
                    d.Face = Enum.NormalId[face]; d.Parent = v
                end
            end
            exPro(v)
        end
    end
    exPro(game.Workspace)

    local s = Instance.new("Sky", game.Lighting)
    for _, side in pairs({"Bk","Dn","Ft","Lf","Rt","Up"}) do
        s["Skybox"..side] = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..skyboxID
    end
    game.Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00:00"

    function applyToCharacter(char)
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        if head then
            local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
            gui.Size = UDim2.new(2.5,0,2.5,0); gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,0.2,0); gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", gui)
            img.Image = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..textureID; img.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            head.Transparency = 1
        end
        if torso then
            local emit = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", torso)
            emit.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..textureID; emit.VelocitySpread = 20
        end
    end

    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then applyToCharacter(player.Character) end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(applyToCharacter)
    end
end)

-- 3. KRYSTAL TEAM
addBtn("KRYSTAL TEAM", Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 130), function()
    local decalID = 278201190
    local faceImageID = 278201073
    function exPro(root)
        for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID then v:Destroy()
            elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
                v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic; v.Transparency = 0
                for _, face in pairs({"Front","Back","Right","Left","Top","Bottom"}) do
                    local d = Instance.new("Decal", v); d.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID; d.Face = Enum.NormalId[face]
                end
            end
            exPro(v)
        end
    end
    exPro(game.Workspace)
    local s = Instance.new("Sky", game.Lighting)
    for _, side in pairs({"Bk","Dn","Ft","Lf","Rt","Up"}) do s["Skybox"..side] = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID end
    function applyToCharacter(char)
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        if head then
            local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head); gui.Size = UDim2.new(2.5,0,2.5,0); gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", gui); img.Image = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..faceImageID; img.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); img.BackgroundTransparency = 1; head.Transparency = 1
        end
        if torso then
            local emit = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", torso); emit.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..decalID; emit.VelocitySpread = 20
        end
    end
    for _, p in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do if p.Character then applyToCharacter(p.Character) end p.CharacterAdded:Connect(applyToCharacter) end
end)

-- 4. RAINING TACOS
addBtn("RAINING TACOS", Color3.fromRGB(220, 160, 0), function()
    local s = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace); s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://142376088"; s:Play()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Raining-tacos-59989"))()
end)

-- [ 5-16: Scripts restantes se mantienen igual... ]
addBtn("RC7 EXPLOIT", Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Rc7-By-Emoxby31-195434"))() end)
addBtn("NYAN CAT", Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-nyan-cat-141395"))() end)
addBtn("NOOB SKIN", Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 0), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KietVN022023/Fe-Noob-lnfecIon/refs/heads/main/Fe%20Noob%20lnfecIon"))() end)
addBtn("FLY V3 X", Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 220), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Fly-V3-X-132770"))() end)
addBtn("ENERGIZE", Color3.fromRGB(0, 160, 70), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Energize-10408"))() end)
addBtn("SHEDLETSKY SKY", Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 0), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Skybox-shedletsky-PLS-DONT-COPY-MY-SCRIPT-SKID-134592"))() end)
addBtn("EPIKGUY GUI", Color3.fromRGB(120, 50, 255), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Epikguy-gui-v2-op-87889"))() end)
addBtn("SSP AGENT", Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 180), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-SSP-AGENT-EDITION-44093"))() end)
addBtn("JOHN DOE", Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-John-Doe-131661"))() end)
addBtn("CHICKEN ARMS", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Head-Shake-and-Chicken-arms-74734"))() end)
addBtn("SNOOP FACE ALL", Color3.fromRGB(150, 80, 255), function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Snoop-Dogg-face-all-116660"))() end)
addBtn("ANONYMUS PARTICLES", Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), function()
    for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local t = v.Character and (v.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or v.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        if t then local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", t); e.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=127476787" end
    end
end)

-- Botón Cerrar
local close = Instance.new("TextButton", main_panel)
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30); close.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.03, 0)
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 60, 60); close.Text = "X"; close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Instance.new("UICorner", close).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() tilin_gui:Destroy() end)

-- Footer
local footer = Instance.new("TextLabel", main_panel)
footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20); footer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.95, 0)
footer.Text = "tilin257222 | TikTok @gatotontoxdd"; footer.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); footer.BackgroundTransparency = 1; footer.TextSize = 10
